thesis: AMPH is in an uptrend (above SMA20 28.00, SMA50 26.51 and SMA200 22.38, 63-day return +31%) and is pulling back to SMA20 and the floor of its 28-29.7 post-earnings range. Revenue growth is accelerating (+8.2% YoY in Q3) and the stock is cheap (forward P/E 8.4), and healthcare (XLV) is one of only three sectors holding above its 50-day in this risk-off tape. Reward/risk from the 28.1 midpoint is about 3.9 (2.9 up to the 31.0 high, 0.75 down to the 27.35 stop), so the trade has positive expectancy even with a low hit rate. That justifies a small Overweight rather than a Buy.
invalidation: Daily close below 27.35, or a close back below SMA20 (about 28.0) on rising volume.
key_risks: Extreme risk-off regime (QQQ 21-day -13.63%, VIX 31.34 at 1-year percentile 0.991) can drag defensives too
Stop is only about 0.7 ATR (1.12) below entry, so a noise stop-out is likely
Price 28.25 is above the 24.5 mean analyst target with a 'Reduce' consensus; a downgrade could hit the stock
The 11/06 spike to 31.0 reversed and the 28-29.7 range is rolling over; 21.7% short interest means sharp reversals both ways
Correlated healthcare exposure (lessons item 8) and leverage (691.7M debt vs 9.2M FCF)
